title: SubjectIdentity contribution value
description: Value type for contributions on the SubjectIdentity panel. Asserts: 'these SourceInterpretations describe a single GSM subject of the given kind, with this identity key.' Posted by IdentificationKSs and refined by ReconciliationKSs.

identityKey.description: Canonical identity within the Run (e.g. 'mechanism:com.acme.payment.PayService#charge'). Two SubjectIdentity contributions with the same identityKey describe the same subject.

interpretsIds.description: Ids of SourceInterpretation contributions this identity is grounded in. ReconciliationKSs grow this list when merging.
